rationale: Notebook switches now come from the typed profile loader; defaults are identical, so a bare run reproduces the notebook.
Resume target selectable from the CLI.
Storage roots and the harness's V1x_* size overrides arrive through the loader instead of source edits; scientific overrides remain visible in the protocol exactly as before.
Local dual-GPU selection without editing source.
Colab/Drive resolution becomes a storage adapter with identical branch semantics; no /content path remains in the core.
HF model loading moved verbatim into dci.inference.hf_transformers; the stage now binds the backend chosen by execution config. load/free/tokenizer semantics, gating and fingerprint checks unchanged.

The whole-text-verifiers-never-segment tripwire now monkey-patches split_sentences where the verifier rules actually resolve it (the extracted library), preserving the probe's full detection power; patching the stage module would have weakened it silently.
Import for the deterministic sharding hooks.
Completeness barrier for sharded workers; identity when unsharded.
generate_batch delegates to the frozen backend; the oracle branch and the torch branch moved verbatim into dci.inference.*.
Deterministic batch-to-worker assignment (batch_index mod N) from the frozen plan; absent sharding this is the identity.
